list.name: run_id
list.label: Run
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "energy", tag: "run_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_metric", start: -30d)

panels.title: Producer rate (records/s)
panels.description: Achieved emission rate of the replay producer vs. the configured load profile.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_metric" and r.name == "producer.rate_rps" and r.run_id =~ /${run_id:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["instance", "_field"])

from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "internal_write" and r._field == "metrics_written" and r.output == "influxdb_v2")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag (records)
panels.description: Records the group is behind the log end. Sustained growth = the consumer cannot keep up.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "energy")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_metric" and r.name == "kafka.consumer_lag" and r.run_id =~ /${run_id:regex}/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["instance", "_field"])

panels.title: End-to-end latency: producer -> queryable in InfluxDB (ms)

from(bucket: "energy")

panels.description: Growth here means InfluxDB writes are slower than ingestion.
